text:
maria: saw weird operator 'garden-path' where private->dedicated->hosted fallback happened but console only reported 'fallback executed'. no reason, no tenant id. ops couldn't tell if this was KMS, quota, or runtime OOM.

sanjay: ugh. root cause? any logs? example traces?

maria: snippet from controlplane logs:
```
2026-03-18T14:22:10Z ERROR fallback: route=hosted tenant=acme reason=proxy_connect_timeout
2026-03-18T14:22:10Z INFO fallback: selected_variant=hosted.model-x qps=12
```
console showed only INFO fallback message; error was swallowed by adapter layer.

aj: we should expose 'fallback_reason' + 'origin_mode' in telemetry. also add correlation_id propagated to console.

elaine: agree. propose RFC: 'mode-isolation-observability' small change: add fields to span / metric tags and surface in console and on-call page. add operator docs on interpretation.

maria: also recommend an 'isolation_enforcement' flag per-tenant to disable cross-mode fallback for high-compliance tenants. sample config:
```
mode_policy:
  tenant: acme
  enforce_mode_isolation: true
  fallback_policy: deny
```

sanjay: minor nit: deny vs warn? deny will drop requests; we should offer 'reject_with_403' and 'route_with_logging' options.

aj: agreed. i'll prototype telemetry tags and add a lightweight circuit-breaker to scheduler that checks tenant policy before routing. won't block fallback logic, but will emit an event and metric.

ops-bot: @maria created task INF-1123 to draft RFC and INF-1124 to add telemetry tags :white_check_mark:

maria: i'll draft RFC today and link PR. sanjay/aj can review. can we aim to land telemetry changes in 2 weeks? :thumbsup:

elaine: ack. i'll update runbook once RFC lands.

sanjay: +1

aj: +1
